nodes.name: Health Alert Webhook
nodes.notes: Production URL: POST <n8n base>/webhook/health-alert. Called by the Cloudflare ingress worker's scheduled health cron when GET origin /healthz fails (ARCHITECTURE.md section 13). Payload shape is Agent 7's; this flow is tolerant of any/malformed body. Same auth note as owner-notify: keep internal or front with the HMAC-validated Cloudflare /hook/* route.

nodes.name: Format Health Alert
nodes.notes: Normalizes the Cloudflare report into the standard {severity, code, message, meta} envelope. Defaults keep a malformed/empty payload deliverable: severity=critical, code=ORIGIN_DOWN.

string.name: message
string.value: ={{ (($json.body || {}).message || ('Cloudflare health cron reports the origin is DOWN (healthz failed)' + ((($json.body || {}).origin) ? ' for ' + ($json.body || {}).origin : ''))).toString() }}

nodes.name: Forward To Owner Notify
nodes.notes: Forwards the normalized envelope to the owner_notify workflow's webhook (env NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL) so ALL notification-transport configuration lives in exactly one place (owner_notify's placeholder node). owner_notify must be ACTIVE. onError=continue so the Cloudflare cron still gets a 200 and does not retry-storm; a failed forward stays visible in n8n's execution list.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: $json.severity, code: $json.code, message: $json.message, meta: JSON.parse($json.meta_json) }) }}
